description: List racing arbs in races still to run: a bookmaker's win price that beats the Betfair Exchange win lay, so backing at the bookmaker and laying on the exchange returns a profit either way. Shows the back and lay stakes, the liability, the money available at the lay price and the profit after commission. Australian races by default. Needs Pro or the free Pro trial; 10 credits a call.

back_stake.description: Back stake in dollars, to work out the lay stake. Default 100.

code.description: thoroughbred, harness or greyhound. Leave it out for all three.

commission.description: Your Betfair commission as a fraction. Default 0.05 (5%).

hours_ahead.description: Races starting within this many hours. Default 3, at most 24.

min_margin_pct.description: Only arbs paying at least this percent of the back stake

name: racing_arbs
title: Racing arbs
